subject: Marketplace integration eligibility + SKU mapping for AtlasCloud listing
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@atlascloud.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudmarketplace.co>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace integration eligibility + SKU mapping for AtlasCloud listing

Hi Maya / Alex,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — excited about AtlasCloud joining the marketplace. To keep momentum I put together a short checklist of what we need from your side to progress to a co-sell-ready catalog listing:

- SKU mapping: one row per SKU + billing model (subscription/usage) and metering units
- Technical evidence: basic integration spec + a 30-minute tech walkthrough
- Compliance artifacts: SOC 2 summary (or letter) + data retention policy
- Commercial: preferred listing name, logo, and desired pricing band (high/med/low)

I attached a lightweight integration checklist and a SKU mapping template to make this easy. Can you confirm owners for each item and whether the team can complete this in two weeks? If so we'll target a listing intake on 6/30.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_integration_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), sku_mapping_template.csv (csv)

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace integration eligibility + SKU mapping for AtlasCloud listing

Hey Rafael,

Great — thanks for the clear checklist. Team can own this. Quick answers:

- SKU mapping: will populate sku_mapping_template.csv. Owner: me (Maya).
- Tech walkthrough: Alex will coordinate a 30-min slot next week (he's cc'd).
- SOC 2: we have a 2025 Type II summary; legal copied here to confirm shareable version.
- Pricing band: we prefer "mid" to start, will confirm list price after ingestion.

Two-week timeline is workable; target intake 6/30 is fine. We’ll upload artifacts to the Drive folder you shared and post the HubSpot deal link once SKUs are in.

Maya
Head of Partnerships, AtlasCloud
maya@atlascloud.com | +1 212-555-3209
